title: Player outfits (data/outfits.yaml)
description: docs/06 "Looks": the looks a player character is drawn with, as an engine humanoid. The default (citizen) gives the body and the clothes shown where nothing is equipped; a shop outfit (costume) covers the torso, legs and feet even over armour (the helmet, the shield and the weapon still show). The sprite folder holds one still preview per facing (<sprite>/<dir>_0), for the shop and as a fallback.

sprite.description: Sprite folder of the preview frames (outfits/citizen).

frames.description: Preview frames per facing: 1 (the standing pose, drawn by the sprite engine).

look.description: The body a player with this outfit is drawn with until the character's own look arrives (feat/character-look).

clothes.description: Torso, legs and feet of the outfit.

costume.description: A shop outfit: its clothes cover the torso, legs and feet even over armour. Without it the clothes only show where nothing is equipped.
